hero.description: The definitive software for engineering and science students and professionals. Over 41 algorithms, differential and integral calculus, ODEs, and a vector KaTeX step-by-step report generator.
hero.official_sources: Direct downloads and official app store releases

features.header_subtitle: Designed to overcome manual calculation limitations with mathematical rigor, typographic clarity, and a didactic approach.
features.card1_desc: Comprehensive curve analysis, Riemann sums, integral applications, series, separable/linear differential equations, and slope fields.
features.card2_desc: Vector SVG rendering for complex math and subscripts (xᵢ, yᵢ, R_{i,0}), university test covers, and dynamic pagination with zero clipping.
features.card3_desc: Write mathematical functions naturally (e.g. "2x + sin(x)") with typo tolerance and real-time LaTeX rendering directly beneath input fields.
features.card4_desc: Precision stepper from 0 to 15 decimals, step-by-step iteration tables, and responsive typography adapting to host OS font scaling.
features.cta_desc: Official installers and direct executables for your operating system.
